title: Exploit: Intro to the Cyber Range
description:
EXPLOIT — Intro to the Cyber Range

​Curious about cybersecurity and ethical hacking? EXPLOIT is a beginner-friendly, practical cybersecurity workshop organised by Cyber Cell, SATI Vidisha, exclusively for first-year students interested in cybersecurity.

​Discover how cybersecurity works, explore career opportunities, watch practical demonstrations, and challenge yourself through interactive activities. No prior cybersecurity experience is required—just curiosity and a willingness to learn.
longDescription:
​What to Expect
​Phase 01 — Explore Cybersecurity
Get introduced to cybersecurity, discover its major domains and career paths, and learn which foundational skills to develop as a first-year student.

​Phase 02 — Think Like an Attacker
Experience cybersecurity through practical demonstrations and understand how security weaknesses can be identified, why they matter, and how systems can be better protected.

​Phase 03 — Your First Cyber Challenge
Put your thinking skills to the test through beginner-friendly cybersecurity challenges. Learn by exploring, solving problems, and discovering new concepts.

​The session focuses on practical learning, audience participation, and building a strong starting point for your cybersecurity journey—not just theory.
